'''Alex Schulman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Kashyyyk Regionals]] on 22 July 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1066">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-boxboro-ma-7-22-2000d1066/ boxboro-ma-7-22-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 31 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-boxboro-ma-7-22-2000d1066/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
